scope: The unchanged C logger extracted from the pinned built bridge encodes ten retained native memory metadata inventories growing from one to five objects. Five complete frames and five unchanged-body reuse frames reconstruct every metadata byte, including new identities and bounded names. Array payload/cache compactness is separately tested by memory_growth_compact.py. This replay does not claim a new HDL execution, destruction/reuse, or operational board cost.

nativeGrowth.scope: Native opt-in allocation after initial inventory adds static 8-bit and signed 80-bit memories with ascending/descending declared ranges. Fresh identities, complete X-bearing payloads, unchanged prior state and lazy word caches are checked across continuation. Destruction, address reuse, compact logging and operational board qualification remain separate.
